title: Curate AI
tagline: Curate AI is a decentralized content-sharing platform powered by blockchain and AI. Users vote on content using tokens, and creators earn rewards based on engagement. AI ensures fairness by monitoring abuse, while tokenomics incentivize participation and value creation.
description:
Curate AI is a blockchain-based content-sharing platform designed to revolutionize how creators and consumers interact. Unlike traditional platforms, Curate AI decentralizes control, giving users real influence through token-based voting. Creators are rewarded based on engagement, ensuring fair compensation for their work.

The platform integrates AI with 50% voting power to monitor and prevent abuses like vote manipulation and low-quality content. The AI analyzes posts for sentiment, bias, plagiarism, and readability, blending its ratings with user votes to compute final scores. Content receives token rewards, distributed transparently via blockchain proportionately.

Tokenomics play a key role in value creation. Users with more tokens have greater voting power, and tokens can be burned to advertise posts. This creates a self-sustaining ecosystem where participation is incentivized, and token value grows organically.

Future enhancements include a decentralized agent network (DAO) for content moderation and UX improvements to make the platform more intuitive and user-friendly. Curate AI aims to create a fair, transparent, and rewarding ecosystem for all participants.
how_its_made:
Curate AI is built using a robust stack of modern technologies, ensuring scalability, transparency, and user-friendly functionality:

Coinbase Agent Kit: Powers the platform's on-chain operations, enabling seamless token distribution, wallet balance checks, and batch payments. This ensures efficient and secure handling of transactions.

Fetches Posts: Uses pagination to retrieve posts from an external API.

Analyzes Content: Applies AI to evaluate sentiment, bias, plagiarism, and readability, generating an AI rating.

Computes Final Scores: Blends user ratings with AI ratings to determine the final score for each post.

Ranks Posts: Ranks content based on final scores and distributes tokens to top entries in a batch call.

Handles Payments: Checks wallet balances and manages on-chain payments as needed.

Solidity: The backbone of our smart contracts, Solidity is used to create transparent and trustless mechanisms for voting, rewards distribution, and token burning for advertising.

Subgraph: Utilized for efficient querying of blockchain data, Subgraph ensures fast and reliable access to on-chain information, such as voting history, token balances, and content rankings.

Supabase DB: Acts as the centralized database for off-chain data, storing user profiles, AI-generated content ratings, and post metadata. Supabase provides a scalable and real-time backend solution, enhancing the platform's performance.
